title: Domain History Contact OSINT Output
description: A per-domain intelligence report plus a separate contacts table where every single contact carries the source URL and capture timestamp that produced it.

domainReports.title: Domain Reports
domainReports.description: One row per domain submitted. Always populated even when the domain is dead: carries liveStatus, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS and passive-DNS history, certificate transparency, hosting and nameserver history, archive timeline, inbound references, embedded identifiers, and a sources[] array stating which sources answered and which returned nothing.

contacts.title: Contacts With Provenance
contacts.description: One row per contact per source. Emails, phones, people and organisations, each with sourceUrl, snapshotTimestamp, extractionMethod, confidence and a full sightings array. This is the evidence-grade output.
